questions.question: Calculate the Net Present Value (NPV) for the proposed project using the discount factors provided in Extract A. Show your working.
questions.modelAnswer: Multiply each year's net cash flow by its respective discount factor, then sum them up and subtract the initial capital outlay.
questions.reasoning: 1 mark for identifying discount factor multiplication, 2 marks for correct mathematical products, 1 mark for final subtraction yielding correct NPV total.
